capabilities: Capture text from a menu bar icon or user-set global shortcut while in any app
File captures to the daily note, inbox folder, task note or user-defined destinations
Parse due dates, times and projects from natural language in task captures
Save pasted, dropped or attached pictures along with the capture
Add custom destinations with folders, tags, properties or templates
extras: Desktop only: the icon uses an unofficial part of Obsidian's desktop app, so it vanishes if Obsidian quits and may break in a future Obsidian version; phones are unsupported. Local-only, nothing is sent anywhere. Full details are in a separate PDF manual.
problem: Obsidian can only capture a thought while you are inside the app, so ideas from other apps are lost or written down elsewhere.

relations.evidence: A free companion to LifeWorld. It also works on its own.

summary: Menu bar icon and global shortcut that capture thoughts into the vault as daily-note lines, inbox notes, tasks or custom note types.
